t: What Are Futures & How Does Futures Trading Work?
s: A common question among those new to the concept of shorting is, ‘how can you sell something you do not own?’ When you are the seller of a futures contract, you agree to sell the underlying asset at a later date, at the futures contract price. In summary, when going long, you hope to profit by selling the asset at a higher price. You would close a long position to sell it. Conversely, you hope to profit by closing your short position at a lower price when going short. To close a short position, you must buy (or cover) it.
